events.summary: You find a note containing a card. You may choose to Take the stored card and Give a card in your deck in return, leaving it with a note so that you may have a chance to retrieve it in another run.
choices: Take and Give: Receive and Store a Card
Ignore: Nothing happens. You are then given the option to Leave.

events.name: Ancient Writing
events.summary: You encounter a wall covered with the writing of the ancients. You can either remove a single card from your deck or Upgrade all Strikes and Defends.
choices: Elegance: Remove a card from your deck.
Simplicity: Upgrade all Strikes and Defends.

events.name: Augmenter
events.summary: A shady man approaches who wants to do an experiment on you. You choose between J.A.X., transforming two cards in your deck, and Mutagenic Strength.
choices: Test J.A.X.: Get JAXXED.
Become Test Subject: Transform 2 cards.
Ingest Mutagens: Obtain a special relic.

events.name: Big Fish
events.summary: You choose between a reward of max health, healing, or a relic. However, choosing the relic Curses you.
choices: Banana: Heal 1/3 of your max HP.
Donut: Max HP +5.
Box: Obtain a Relic. Become Cursed - Regret. You are then given the option to Leave.

events.name: Bonfire Spirits
events.summary: You come across a bonfire surrounded by spirits. You may choose to Offer a card to the spirits and receive a reward according to its rarity.
choices: Offer: Receive a reward based on the offer.

events.name: Council of Ghosts
events.summary: A group of apparitions approaches you. One of them offers a taste of their power. You can refuse, or obtain 3 Apparitions and lose half of your max health.
choices: Accept: Receive 5 A15: (3) Apparitions. Lose X Max HP.
Refuse: Nothing happens. You are then given the option to Leave.

events.name: Cursed Tome
events.summary: You find a cursed tome with insight into Neow's origins. If you choose to read through it, you are damaged by its power. Once finished, you can obtain one of Necronomicon, Enchiridion, Nilry's Codex at random, or leave without it.
choices: Read
Continue: Lose 1 HP.
Continue: Lose 2 HP.
Continue: Lose 3 HP.
Take: Obtain the book. Lose 10 (15) HP.
Stop: Lose 3 HP.

Leave: Nothing happens. === Practical Options === Because the player can choose to leave the event immediately and lose 0 HP instead of selecting Continue 3 times and then backing out with Stop while losing a total of 9 HP, there are really only 2 practical ways to ...

events.name: Dead Adventurer
events.summary: You come across an adventurer killed by an elite enemy. You can choose to search for a relic or some gold with the chance that the creature will return.
choices: Search: Find Loot. 25% A15: (35%): monster returns.
Leave: Nothing happens.

events.name: Designer In-Spire
events.summary: You encounter a snobby shop owner who reluctantly offers his services. His services can Upgrade, Transform, or remove some cards from your deck.
choices: Adjustments: Lose 40 (50) Gold. One of the following rewards appears.
Clean Up: Lose 60 (75) Gold. One of the following rewards appears.
Full Service: Lose 90 (110) Gold. Remove a card, then upgrade a random card.
Punch: Lose 3 (5) HP.

events.name: Duplicator
events.summary: You encounter a shrine with the power to duplicate a card in your deck.
choices: Pray: Duplicate a card in your deck.
Leave: Nothing happens.

events.name: Face Trader
events.summary: You encounter a strange man who offers a selection of face relics. You can also choose to touch the man, gaining gold in exchange for health.
choices: Touch: Lose X HP, gain 75 A15: (50) Gold.
Trade: 50%: Good Face. 50%: Bad Face.
Leave: Nothing happens.

events.name: Falling
events.summary: You slip off one of the floating platforms in the Beyond. In order to land safely, you are forced to sacrifice a card.
choices: Land: Lose (a random Skill)
Channel: Lose (a random Power)

Strike: Lose (a random Attack) If the player somehow manages to lack even a single eligible card (e.g. they have a very small deck containing only bottled cards), then the only option listed is a special Land option that has no description.

events.name: Forgotten Altar
events.summary: You find a statue that requires an offering. Your options are to offer Golden Idol in exchange for Bloody Idol, gain max health but become damaged, or desecrate it and become Cursed.
choices: Offer: Golden Idol: Obtain a special Relic. Lose Golden Idol.
Sacrifice: Gain 5 Max HP. Lose X HP.
Desecrate: Become Cursed -Decay.

events.name: Golden Idol
events.summary: You come across a golden idol. You can choose to walk past, or grab it and choose how to defend yourself.

events.name: Golden Shrine
events.summary: You encounter a shrine made of gold. You can choose to pray for gold or destroy it for more and become Cursed.
choices: Pray: Gain 100 Gold.
Desecrate: Gain 275 Gold. Become Cursed - Regret.
Leave: Nothing happens.

events.name: Hypnotizing Colored Mushrooms
events.summary: You find an area full of brightly colored mushrooms. You can choose to eat one to heal but obtain a Curse or fight Fungi Beasts to obtain a special Relic.
choices: Stomp: Anger the Mushrooms.
Eat: Heal X HP. Become Cursed - Parasite.

events.name: Knowing Skull
events.summary: You encounter a talking skull that can grant many rewards in exchange for health.
choices: A Pick Me Up?: Get a Potion. Lose X HP.
Riches?: Gain 90 Gold. Lose X HP.
Success?: Get a Colorless card. Lose X HP.
How do I leave?: Lose X HP.

events.name: Lab
events.summary: You find a lab filled with potions, collecting 3 of them.
choices: Search: Find some Potions!

events.name: Living Wall
events.summary: The walls come down around you, in order to pass you must either remove, Transform, or Upgrade a card.
choices: Forget: Remove a card from your deck.
Change: Transform a card in your deck.
Grow: Upgrade a card in your deck.

events.name: Masked Bandits
events.summary: A group of bandits stops you and forces you to pay all of your gold to pass. You can fight the bandits for Red Mask, or pay up to skip the fight.
choices: Pay: Lose ALL of your Gold.
Fight!

events.name: Match and Keep
events.summary: You are forced to play a card matching game. You get 5 attempts, any cards you match will be added to your deck, even Curses.
choices: Play

events.name: Mind Bloom
events.summary: Your imagination manifests into reality. In this ephemeral moment, all your wishes can come true, though not without consequences.
choices: I am War: Fight a Boss from Act 1. Obtain a Rare Relic.
I am Awake: Upgrade all cards. You can no longer heal.
I am Rich: Gain 999 Gold. Cursed - 2 Normality.
I am Healthy: Heal to full HP. Cursed - Doubt.

events.name: Mysterious Sphere
events.summary: You come across a treasure encased in a sphere of bone, with automatons guarding it.
choices: Open Sphere: Fight. Reward: Rare Relic.
Leave: Nothing happens.

events.name: N'loth
events.summary: A strange creature offers you a gift in exchange for a relic for him to feed on.
choices: Offer: Relic A: Lose this relic. Obtain a special relic.
Offer: Relic B: Lose this relic. Obtain a special relic.
Leave: Nothing happens.

events.name: Old Beggar
events.summary: An old beggar asks for you to give some Gold to him.
choices: Offer Gold: 75 Gold: Remove a card from your deck.
Leave: Nothing happens.

events.name: Ominous Forge
events.summary: You come across a forge, you can choose to Upgrade a card or obtain a Relic along with a Curse.
choices: Forge: Upgrade a card in your deck.
Rummage: Obtain a special relic. Become Cursed - Pain.
Leave: Nothing happens.

events.name: Pleading Vagrant
events.summary: You encounter a homeless beggar who offers a Relic in exchange for gold. You can also rob him of it and become Cursed, or leave.
choices: Offer Gold: 85 Gold: Obtain a Relic.
Rob: Obtain a Relic. Become Cursed - Shame.
Leave: Nothing happens.

events.name: Purifier
events.summary: You encounter a shrine with the power to remove a card from your deck.
choices: Pray: Remove a card from your deck.
Leave: Nothing happens.

events.name: Scrap Ooze
events.summary: You come across a slime creature who has eaten large amounts of metal scrap. You can choose to pass it, or spend health for a chance to obtain a Relic.
choices: Reach Inside: Lose 3 A15: (5) HP. 25% chance to find a Relic.
Leave: Nothing happens.

events.name: Secret Portal
events.summary: You encounter a strange mystical portal with the power to send you directly to the boss of the Beyond.
choices: Enter the Portal: IMMEDIATELY travel to the boss.
Leave: Nothing happens.

events.name: Sensory Stone
events.summary: You find a glowing tesseract containing distant memories. It offers Colorless cards, but the more you ask for, the more damage you take.
choices: Recall: Add 1 Colorless card to your deck.
Recall: Add 2 Colorless cards to your deck. Lose 5 HP.
Recall: Add 3 Colorless cards to your deck. Lose 10 HP.

events.name: Shining Light
events.summary: You come across a mass of bright light. You can either pass or spend health to Upgrade two cards.
choices: Enter: Upgrade 2 random cards. Lose X HP.
Leave: Nothing happens.

events.name: The Cleric

choices: Heal: 35 Gold: Heal X HP.

Leave: Nothing happens.

events.name: The Colosseum
events.summary: You are kidnapped and trapped in an arena, forced to fight two Slavers. Afterwards, you can either leave or fight a Taskmaster and a Gremlin Nob together for 100 Gold, a card reward, an Uncommon Relic and a Rare Relic.
choices: Fight: After the fight ends, a choice has to be made:
COWARDICE: Escape.

events.name: The Divine Fountain
events.summary: You encounter a fountain of sacred water with a power to cleanse you of Curses.
choices: Drink: Remove all Curses from your deck.
Leave: Nothing happens.

choices: Murderer: Bet 50 Gold - 70%: win 100 Gold.
Owner: Bet 50 Gold - 30%: win 250 Gold. There is no option to avoid betting.

events.name: The Library
events.summary: You encounter an ornate library. You can rest to restore your health, or choose from a selection of 20 cards to add to your deck.
choices: Read: Choose 1 of 20 cards to add to your deck.
Sleep: Heal X HP.

choices: Open Coffin: Obtain a Relic. 50% A15: (100%): Become Cursed - Writhe
Leave: Nothing happens.

events.name: The Moai Head
events.summary: An oddly placed Moai head is along your path. It is covered with depictions of people throwing themselves into its mouth. You can choose to do the same, or offer Golden Idol for riches.
choices: Jump Inside: Heal to full HP. Lose X Max HP.
Offer: {{R: }} Receive 333 Gold. Lose Golden Idol.

events.name: The Nest

choices: Smash and Grab: Obtain 99 A15: (50) Gold.
Stay in Line: Obtain Ritual Dagger. Lose 6 HP.

events.name: The Ssssserpent

choices: Agree: Gain 175 A15: (150) Gold. Become Cursed - Doubt.

events.name: The Woman in Blue

choices: Buy 1 Potion: 20 Gold.
Buy 2 Potions: 30 Gold.
Buy 3 Potions: 40 Gold.
Leave: Nothing happens.

events.name: Tomb of Lord Red Mask
events.summary: You come across a mysterious tomb in the Beyond. You can offer all of your coins for the Red Mask, or put it on yourself for Gold if you already have it.

Locked: Requires: Red Mask
Offer: X Gold: Lose all Gold. Obtain a Relic.

choices: Pray: Transform a card.
Leave: Nothing happens.

events.name: Upgrade Shrine

choices: Pray: Upgrade a card.
Leave: Nothing happens.

events.summary: A group of hooded figures taking part in some kind of ritual offer to let you join. Joining the ritual replaces all Strikes with Bite cards in exchange for 30% of your max HP. If you have the Blood Vial, you may exchange it instead of losing max HP.

events.name: We Meet Again!

choices: Give Potion: Lose a chosen potion. Obtain a Relic.
Give Gold: Lose Gold. Obtain a Relic.
Give Card: Lose a chosen card. Obtain a Relic.
Attack: Nothing happens.

events.name: Wheel of Change
events.summary: You are forced to spin a wheel to gain a prize, not all of which are positive.
choices: Play

events.name: Winding Halls

Focus: Become Cursed - Writhe. Heal X HP.

events.name: Wing Statue

choices: Pray: Remove a card from your deck. Lose 7 HP.
Destroy: Receive 50 - 80 Gold.
Leave: Nothing happens.

events.name: World of Goop
events.summary: You fall into a puddle of slime which makes you lose some of your gold. You can choose to retrieve it, damaging yourself, or leave it behind.
choices: Gather Gold: Gain 75 Gold. Lose 11 HP.
Leave It: Lose X Gold.

run.acts: 3 acts (Exordium, The City, The Beyond) of 17 floors each; optional Act 4 (The Ending, floors 52-56) needs all 3 keys. Run starts with Neow; floor counter 1-51 for acts 1-3.
run.start: 99 Gold, 3 potion slots (A11: 2), starter relic, 10-12 card starter deck, 3 Energy, draw 5. Hand limit 10.
run.act_transition: Act 1/2 boss -> card reward (3 Rares) + Gold + maybe potion; next floor (17/34) is the Boss Chest (choose 1 of 3 Boss relics or skip). Heal 100% of missing HP (A5: 75%) after the boss. Act 3 boss ends the run unless all 3 keys are held.

map.layout: Each act: 15 map rows + boss (floor 16) + boss chest (floor 17). Up to 6 rooms per row; each room has 1-3 paths to the next row; paths are revealed one act at a time.
map.fixed_floors: Row 1 = normal fights from the easy pool; row 9 = Treasure on every node; row 15 = Rest Site on every node; 16 = boss.

room_odds.note: A1: ~60% more elites. Treasure only on the fixed row 9 (and from ? rooms).

map.constraints_not_on_wiki: From the game's map generator (not stated on the wiki): no Elite/Rest below row 6, no Rest on row 14, no two Elite/Rest/Merchant in a row on a path, sibling branches from one node differ in type.
map.monster_pools: First 3 fights in Act 1 (2 in Acts 2-3) come from the easy pool, the rest from the hard pool (weighted); the same encounter cannot recur within the next 2 fights; a few hard-pool fights are banned right after a similar easy fight.
map.elite_rules: Same elite may repeat within an act but never twice in a row.
map.unknown_room: ? resolves on entry: base Monster 10%, Shop 3%, Treasure 2%, else Event; each type not rolled grows by its base value and resets when rolled (values from the StS2 wiki page; the StS1 page's odds section is empty but the game uses the same scheme). Shrine events are 25% of event rolls. Juzu Bracelet removes Monster.

rewards.source: Cards, Gold, Potions, Relics, Elites, Bosses, Mechanics
rewards.card_reward: Choose 1 of 3 (or skip). Rarity base chances normal 60/37/3% (C/U/R), elite 50/40/10%, shop 54/37/9%. Rare pity: offset starts at -5%, +1% per Common rolled, resets on a Rare (first reward of an act cannot be Rare). Upgraded commons/uncommons appear from Act 2 (A12: half as often).
rewards.potion_drop: 40% after combat; -10% after a drop, +10% after none; resets each act. Potion rarity 65/25/10% (C/U/R).
rewards.elite: Relic (C/U/R 50/33/17%) + 25-35 Gold + card reward (elite odds) + maybe potion.
rewards.chests: Small 50% / Medium 33% / Large 17% spawn. Relic rarity small 75/25/0, medium 35/50/15, large 0/75/25 (C/U/R). Gold chance 50/35/50% for 23-27 / 45-55 / 68-82.
rewards.boss_relics: Boss Chest after Act 1/2 boss: pick 1 of 3 Boss relics (strong, usually with a drawback) or skip. Starter relic has a Boss-tier upgrade (e.g. Burning Blood -> Black Blood).

shop.stock: 5 class cards (2 Attack, 2 Skill, 1 Power; one at 50% off), 2 colorless (Uncommon + Rare, +20% price), 3 relics (rightmost always a Shop relic), 3 potions, 1 card removal.

rest_site.options: Rest (heal 30% max HP) or Smith (upgrade 1 card); Recall (take Ruby Key) once Act 4 is unlocked; relics add Lift (Girya, +1 Str up to 3x), Toke (Peace Pipe, remove a card), Dig (Shovel, relic). One action per site; the room before each boss is always a rest site.

neow.rule: Run start bonus. If the last run reached the Act 1 boss: 4 options (card bonus; small bonus such as +Max HP/100 Gold/3 potions/common relic/Neow's Lament; a drawback+big bonus combo; swap starter relic for a random Boss relic). Otherwise 2 options (+Max HP or Neow's Lament: enemies in the next 3 combats have 1 HP).

keys_heart.rule: Unlocked after winning with Ironclad, Silent and Defect. Ruby Key = Recall at a rest site (costs that rest); Emerald Key = defeat the burning 'super elite' (one per act until taken; buffed with +Str, +25% HP, Metallicize or Regenerate); Sapphire Key = take it from a chest instead of the relic. With all 3, Act 4: rest + shop, then Spire Shield & Spire Spear (elite), then the Corrupt Heart (floor 55; A20: 56).

elites_bosses.rule: 3 possible bosses per act, one is shown on the map from the start. A20: two different Act 3 bosses back to back. Act 3/4 bosses give no rewards.

ascension.detail: Only heal for 75% of your missing health after a boss fight instead of 100%.
Lose 10% of your health at the start of a run.
Normal enemies have more health and sometimes gain more Block.
Elites have more health and sometimes gain more Block.
Bosses have more health and sometimes gain more Block.
Start each run with an Ascender's Bane.
Start each run with one less potion slot.
Upgraded cards appear half as often in Act 2 and Act 3.
-5 max HP for Ironclad, -4 max HP for Silent, Defect, and Watcher.
Many events have less positive outcomes and more severe consequences.

ascension.effect: Normal enemies have more challenging movesets and abilities.
Elites have more challenging movesets and abilities.
Bosses have more challenging movesets and abilities.

ascension.name: (Max Level) Double Boss.
ascension.detail: Fight two Bosses at the end of Act 3.
